authoring.what this is: the introduction survey. a deterministic, no-AI list of facet questions. each option carries authored channels; on pick they round up into the RawPortrait, which a downstream AI condenses into the final Portrait. that AI is GIVEN these definitions — so write each fragment to STAND ON ITS OWN. do not prefix it to announce its category (no 'they tend to…', no 'often…'), and do not label identities (no 'THE STRIVER —'). write as if the category is already understood.
authoring.indicator: a fact, localized in the present — what is true of this person right now, given this answer. near-certain.
authoring.implication: speculation — one possible lead. implications are NOT mutually exclusive and need not agree with each other; each is a read the downstream AI can weigh.
authoring.identity: archetypal-trait fragments describing the kind of person who lands here. plural, and they can compete. NO names or labels — just the trait, bare.
authoring.weight: 0-3. how hot this answer runs — emotional + meaningful valence. 0 inert, 1 mild, 2 warm (a real lead), 3 hot (load-bearing). it ONLY sorts the RawPortrait amalgam (high signal rises, low sinks); it never gates or drops anything. weight 3 should mean meaningfully more charge than weight 1.
authoring.shadow: critical. what it means that they did NOT pick this — collected from every option they declined. one line, no announcing prefix; read it as the meaning of the omission.
authoring.hooks: RELATIONAL. fires pairwise against OTHER answers. empty for now.
authoring.notes: DIRECTIVE / operational. not load-bearing right now — leave empty.
authoring._note: first-pass authored content (in-context brainstorm). identities still carry 'someone who / a person who' prefixes to be stripped in the taste pass; shadows are the existing omission-meaning versions. hooks/notes deferred.
